end.parentNote: Asha practised observing and describing bird features by asking Atharv to notice the beak and feet, then guided them to use “hooked beak” and “webbed feet.” Atharv later identified webbed feet as useful for swimming, while the beak’s function needed more prompting and was not fully checked.
